title: AVO: Agentic Variation Operators for Autonomous Evolutionary Search
abstract: arXiv:2603.24517v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic Variation Operators (AVO) are a new family of evolutionary variation operators that replace the fixed mutation, crossover, and hand-designed heuristics of classical evolutionary search with autonomous coding agents. Rather than confining a language model to candidate generation within a prescribed pipeline, AVO instantiates variation as a self-directed agent loop that can consult the current lineage, a domain-specific knowledge base, and execution feedback to propose, repair, critique, and verify implementation edits. We evaluate AVO on attention, among the most aggressively optimized kernel targets in AI, on NVIDIA Blackwell (B200) GPUs. Over 7 days of continuous autonomous evolution on multi-head attention, AVO discovers kernels that outperform cuDNN by up to 3.5% and FlashAttention-4 by up to 10.5% across the evaluated configurations. translated_title: AVO：用于自主演化搜索的智能体变异算子
translated_abstract: 智能体变异算子（AVO）是一类新型演化变异算子，它用自主编码智能体取代了经典演化搜索中固定的变异、交叉以及人工设计的启发式方法。AVO并未将语言模型局限于规定流程中的候选生成，而是将变异实现为一个自主导向的智能体循环，该循环可以查询当前谱系、领域特定知识库和执行反馈，从而提出、修复、批评和验证实现修改。我们在NVIDIA Blackwell（B200）GPU上，针对注意力机制——AI领域中优化竞争最激烈的内核目标之一——对AVO进行了评估。经过7天对多头注意力的连续自主演化，AVO发现的内核在所有评估配置下性能比cuDNN高出最多3.5%，比FlashAttention-4高出最多10.5%。所发现的优化可以轻松迁移到分组查询注意力，仅需……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: AVO用自主编码智能体取代传统演化搜索中的固定变异算子，在B200 GPU上经过7天连续自主演化，发现了性能超越cuDNN达3.5%、超越FlashAttention-4达10.5%的注意力内核优化方案。
en_tdlr: AVO replaces the fixed mutation, crossover, and hand-designed heuristics of classical evolutionary search with autonomous coding agents, discovering attention kernel optimizations over 7 days of continuous autonomous evolution that outperform cuDNN by up to 3.5% and FlashAttention-4 by up to 10.5% on NVIDIA B200 GPUs.
